releases.author: kaurimark
releases.description:
## What changed

- Store API keys with Obsidian SecretStorage instead of plaintext plugin settings
- Mask credential controls with Obsidian SecretComponent
- Migrate existing keys without losing or overwriting credentials
- Fix widget rendering across Obsidian pop-out windows
- Harden cache index validation and pass the current Obsidian lint rules

Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer.

releases.author: kaurimark
releases.description:
First public release.

## Features

- Read whole note or just selected text aloud via your TTS provider of choice
- Karaoke-style highlight tracking the spoken word in source mode and Live Preview
- Top-of-file player or draggable floating widget — play/pause, segment skip, stop, 0.75×–2× speed
- Two widget themes: minimal inline chip, or characterful tape-deck
- Disk cache so re-reading a note is instant and free
- Pauses around headings, between paragraphs and list items
- Strips Obsidian-specific syntax (wikilinks, embeds, callouts, highlights, comments, task checkboxes) for natural prose

## Providers

ElevenLabs, Inworld, Fish Audio, Cartesia, OpenAI. Bring your own API key — keys stored locally, never proxied. Karaoke precision is per-character on ElevenLabs and synthesized from audio duration on the others.

## Install

Manual install for now (pending Obsidian community plugins approval).

See README for setup instructions.
